definitions.explanation: Rain that falls heavily or in large amounts.

examples.japanese: {大雨|おおあめ}で{電車|でんしゃ}が{止|と}まった。
examples.english: The train stopped due to heavy rain.

examples.japanese: {大雨|おおあめ}{警報|けいほう}が{出|で}ている。
examples.english: A heavy rain warning has been issued.

examples.japanese: {大雨|おおあめ}が{降|ふ}っている。

notes:
{大雨|おおあめ} combines {大|おお} (big) + {雨|あめ} (rain).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {大雨|おおあめ}が{降|ふ}る (heavy rain falls)
- {大雨|おおあめ}{警報|けいほう} (heavy rain warning)
- {大雨|おおあめ}{注意報|ちゅういほう} (heavy rain advisory)
- {大雨|おおあめ}で{中止|ちゅうし} (cancelled due to heavy rain)

RELATED WEATHER TERMS:
- {大雪|おおゆき}: heavy snow
- {豪雨|ごうう}: torrential rain
- {小雨|こさめ}: light rain
- にわか{雨|あめ}: sudden shower
